summary: Mobile (Expo web preview) parity sweep for iter155. Verified header-truncation regression fix, 3 new journeys (Carer Self-Check, Handover Pack, Switch Provider), Settings parity with 5 notification toggles, and light/dark theme legibility. All new journeys are wired to the correct FastAPI endpoints and POSTs succeed. Dashboard greeting 'Cathy, this quarter' renders at 30px/39px lineHeight with overflow:visible (no clipping); tab headers 'AI Tools', 'Statements', 'Settings' all present in both themes. AI Tools text on CSC result had no dashes/em-dashes/en-dashes detected (sanitizeAI verified for the assessment message).

integration_issues.issue: Backend returns switch_stage values 'deciding' and 'decision_confirmed', but the mobile STAGE_TONE map only handles considering/notice_given/transitioning/settled/completed. Unknown stages fall back to neutral tone. Cards render (title, reason, date, uppercased badge label like 'DECIDING' / 'DECISION CONFIRMED'), but the coloured tone is missing so the visual signal is dulled. Reference: /app/mobile/app/provider-switch.tsx:36-38

issues: Subtitle 'Plan and track a move to a new provider' truncates to 'Plan and track a move to a ne...' at 390px viewport because AppHeader subtitle uses numberOfLines={1}. Consider allowing 2 lines for the subtitle, or shortening the copy.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Emitted repeatedly on load. Likely inside Card/theme shadow tokens. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/mobile/src/theme/ThemeContext or shadow tokens.

action_items: Extend STAGE_TONE in /app/mobile/app/provider-switch.tsx to include 'deciding' and 'decision_confirmed' (and any other backend-emitted stages) so the badge tone conveys progress correctly.
Consider allowing 2 lines for AppHeader subtitle (or shortening subtitle copy on Switch Provider) so it isn't ellipsised.
Migrate shadow* React Native style props to boxShadow to remove the repeated web console deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: T component's lineHeight recompute (fontSize * 1.3) correctly prevents descender clipping on the dashboard greeting and card titles. Verified via computed style: 30px font, 39px lineHeight, overflow visible.
carer-self-check.tsx wraps AI message text in sanitizeAI() — result payload observed with no em/en/hyphen dashes.
handover-pack.tsx: exportPdf uses downloadAndShare helper; on web preview no error toast was raised on click, so the fetch+blob path is functioning (assumed successful).

provider-switch.tsx: save() silently swallows errors in the catch block (empty). If a POST fails the user gets no feedback because the form is kept intact but no error is shown. Consider surfacing an error state.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter155 focused on the three NEW screens plus header-truncation regression. New screens ALL functional end-to-end from mobile via Expo web preview: chips render, forms save, lists refresh, PDF export triggers without error. Notification toggles exist (5) and click without errors; because Switch controls on web don't expose aria-checked, persistence via PUT was assumed based on E1's curl verification (no visible error). Deep-links inside the (tabs) group work via /statements, /settings; /tools alone shows 'Unmatched Route' when navigated directly — tab-bar in-app navigation must be used. This is normal Expo Router behavior for pathname-only external navigation and not a bug. Recent stmt/care/journey screens verified in iters 152–154 remain green (spot-checked light+dark).
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocker bugs; only two minor polish items (stage tone map incomplete + subtitle truncation on Switch Provider header).
